Include the notes file in your commit.
- Commit with a conventional message: type(scope): why-focused, at most 3 sentences. NO attribution of any kind, NO AI/Claude mentions, NO session links, NO em dashes anywhere in code, docs, or commit messages (use commas, colons, parentheses). Do NOT push. Do NOT merge.

- Do not touch vendor/, roster/, dossier/ source. Do not change ADR decisions or CONTEXT.md semantics. Do not refactor beyond your ticket.
- Your final message is machine-read via the schema. Keep strings short. liveVerify = the exact command(s) you ran plus a short observed-output snippet proving the acceptance.

YOUR TICKET: PF-1: Writer stops minting colliding ids

In undefined/feed/src/article-store.ts persistArticle (~lines 55-130), the filename gets a dedup counter (slug-1.md) when a file exists, but articleId is built from the BARE slug, so two same-title same-day same-site articles share one id. 13 such pairs exist in the corpus. Fix: derive articleId from the FINAL deduped filename stem. Check undefined/feed/src/storage.ts (live path, ~line 73) for the same pattern and fix it too if present.
Tests: persist two different articles with identical titles, same day and site, into a temp store: assert two files AND two distinct ids.
Acceptance: unit test proves new writes cannot collide; suite green.

When done: commit (include implementation-notes.md), then fill the schema. If you cannot complete the ticket after honest effort, set status failed and say why in summary.
